title: [Bug] [Dev/Master] Temp Profile switch on AAPSClient with duration, reduced % and Activity TT doesn't activate properly on AAPS (Only NSClientV1)
body:
AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b / AAPSClient 3.3.0-dev-b / master 3.1.0.4
Build: 18887e78ed-2024.09.09
Nightscout version: 15.0.2

Logs from dev:
AAPS: [AndroidAPS_LOG_1726002964538.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16955082/AndroidAPS_LOG_1726002964538.log.zip)
AAPSClient: [AndroidAPS_LOG_1726003014356.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16955090/AndroidAPS_LOG_1726003014356.log.zip)

**Step by step**
1) Use NSClientV1 sync in AAPS/AAPSClient
2) Select profile switch on AAPSClient phone.
3) Select e.g. 30 min duration, 80% strength, Activity TT and click ok.

**Result (dev):** TT is set on AAPS and AAPSClient, but temp profile switch isn't carried out on AAPS.
**Result (master):** TT is NOT set on AAPS, but is set on AAPSClient, temp profile switch is successfully set on AAPS

**Expected result** is that TT, profile% and duration is set correctly on AAPS and AAPSClient.

**Side note**: In master/dev this works fine with NSClientV3. Since behaviour is not the same in master and dev, it's probably best to fix the problem as it stands in dev if it cant be adressed in both environments some how.
